summary: The candidate fixes sequential low-RLIMIT endpoint churn by deriving an fd-aware cache size, but active-sender protection permits unbounded cache overflow. With RLIMIT_NOFILE=128 and every cached endpoint send lock held, real CommonKVManager._connect still fails in monitor creation with ZMQError: Too many open files after 38 endpoints.

tests.what_was_measured: The prepared base reproduced the original real-PyZMQ monitor-socket failure: 38 endpoints completed, the cache reached 39 entries, and get_monitor_socket raised ZMQError: Too many open files.
All 8 candidate regression tests passed against source imported from the exact detached candidate checkout.
Independent sequential churn passed: the derived limit was 21, 1,000 endpoints completed, 21 remained cached, and 76 fds were open.

Independent active-sender adversarial case reproduced the original failure: eviction skipped all busy entries, the cache overflowed its limit of 21 to 38 entries, and real monitor creation raised ZMQError: Too many open files.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and counterexample are in host-side CommonKVManager/PyZMQ descriptor management; no GPU kernel participates. The reporter's 16x H800 distributed workload was unavailable, so no full-workload claim is made.

remaining_counterexamples: When every cached endpoint has an active sender lock, _evict_idle_socket returns false and _connect deliberately permits cache overflow. Under soft RLIMIT_NOFILE=128, 38 busy distinct endpoints exhaust descriptors and real get_monitor_socket raises ZMQError: Too many open files even though the derived cache size is 21.
remaining_limitations: The reporter's 16x NVIDIA H800 full-model, multi-node workload and weights were unavailable; this review validates the actual host-side manager and PyZMQ path only.
The prepared environment is x86_64 with PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2, and PyZMQ 27.2.0; the assigned AMD GPU was not used because the fd lifecycle has no GPU execution.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json reports native as null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
An explicitly oversized SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_ZMQ_SOCKET_CACHE_SIZE remains capable of exceeding the descriptor budget, as the candidate documents.
